source_semantics.behavior: ClearHistory only clears the page-local history collection; it does not delete persisted operation history or call a backend service.
source_semantics.adaptation: Laravel keeps connection-verification history in component-local state and exposes Clear history only when at least one real verification has completed and been authoritatively reread.

security_contract.session_auth: Clear history performs no server action. The real verification that can create a local history entry remains on the existing authenticated Laravel SPA/API session path.
security_contract.active_tenant: history is local to the active tenant/site component and is reset whenever context.tenant.slug or the canonical Site Details endpoint changes
security_contract.permission: the containing control fails closed unless the server-derived frontend context grants connector.manage or wildcard permission
security_contract.idor: Clear history emits no route, tenant ID, site ID, or HTTP request; the underlying verification retains the existing tenant-scoped server route and foreign-tenant direct-ID 404 contract
security_contract.validation: Clear history accepts no user payload or identity/ownership fields
security_contract.csrf: no CSRF-bearing mutation is created for Clear history because it has no server mutation; the existing verification continues through apiRequest CSRF/session handling
security_contract.ownership: no caller-supplied tenant/site ownership is consumed by Clear history; local history is reset on tenant/site context change
security_contract.secret_non_exposure: history copies only normalized connection and health states; unexpected application_password or encrypted_secret fields are never rendered or retained in history
security_contract.truthful_success: a history item is appended only after the real verification POST succeeds and Site Details authoritative reread succeeds
security_contract.retry_idempotency: clearing is an in-memory set-to-empty operation with no persistence or side effect; repeated clear is naturally idempotent
security_contract.provider_failure: verification failure or authoritative reread failure records no local success history
security_contract.queue_cache_scheduler_isolation: Clear history touches no queue, cache, scheduler, persistence, or background job
security_contract.fake_success: no demo/sample result creates history; entries originate only from the existing real verification path after authoritative reread
